`@smg247` Here's a summary of where things stand. Of the 8 actionable findings I raised, 3 are addressed and 5 are still open:

**✅ Addressed (in commit 1cb8403)**
- `.apm/instructions/general.instructions.md` (Line 33) — vendor guidance now says `go mod tidy && go mod vendor`.
- `.devcontainer/README.md` — removed the redundant manual `post-create.sh` bootstrap step.
- `hack/agentic_setup.sh` (Line ~9-11) — now `cd`s into `${REPO_ROOT}` before invoking `post-create.sh`.

**🟡 Still open**
1. **`.agentic/solve-config.md` (Line 9)** — this copy still reads `Run \`go mod vendor\`` only, without `go mod tidy`. The equivalent fix was applied to `.apm/instructions/general.instructions.md` but not here, so it's now inconsistent with the rest of the guidance.
2. **`.apm/prompts/origin-dev-setup.prompt.md` (Line 63)** — Linux podman-docker detection still uses a generic `command -v docker`, which also matches native Docker and can cause the setup flow to skip `--docker-path podman` when it's actually needed.
3. **`.devcontainer/Dockerfile` (Lines 24-30)** — `golangci-lint` and `gh` release artifacts are still downloaded and installed without checksum/signature verification.

5. **`.devcontainer/post-create.sh` (Line 14)** — the Claude Code installer is still piped directly into `sh` (`curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | sh`) without integrity verification.

**Nitpick, unresolved (informational only)**
- `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` (Lines 10-14) — mounting `~/.config/gcloud`, `~/.config/gh`, and `~/.claude` into the container still widens the blast radius if any devcontainer-installed tooling is compromised. This is a design tradeoff worth documenting in the README rather than a hard blocker.

Items 3-5 are the same class of concern (unverified `curl | sh` supply-chain risk) — since this is a dev-only container, you may choose to document that as an accepted risk instead of adding checksum pinning, but worth an explicit call either way.
